sandbox.name: Sandbox
sandbox.flavor: A practice ground with nothing at stake: move, explore and discover the cards at your own pace.
sandbox.objective: None: learn the rules by playing.

first_reconnaissance.name: First Reconnaissance
first_reconnaissance.flavor: An unexplored land lies before you. Your mission: cross it until you find its capital, and come back with all the fame and treasure you can win along the way.
first_reconnaissance.objective:
Explore the land until you reveal a city.
Gain as much Fame as you can on the way.
first_reconnaissance.special_rules:
Each revealed tile gives 1 Fame.
Cities can be neither conquered nor entered.
Tactics: you choose yours first, the Dummy player draws one among the others; both are removed from the game at the end of the Round.
Dummy player: it flips cards from its deck each turn and announces the End of the Round when it is empty.
first_reconnaissance.game_end:
A city is revealed: finish this turn, then play one last turn.
Otherwise, the game ends after the 4th round.
first_reconnaissance.scoring:
Your Fame, plus the Achievements.
No titles in solo play.

scenario.last_turn_next: City revealed: one last turn after this one.

solo_conquest.name: Solo Conquest
solo_conquest.flavor: You are on your own, yet the Council still counts on you: find the two cities of the land and storm them before the third night is over.
solo_conquest.length: 6 rounds: Day, Night, Day, Night, Day, Night
solo_conquest.objective:
Find and conquer both cities: the first one revealed is level 5, the second one level 8.
With both conquered, the mission is accomplished.
solo_conquest.special_rules:
No core tile on the coastline (the two edge lanes).
Tactics: you choose yours first, the Dummy player draws one among the others; both are removed from the game at the end of the Round.
Dummy player: it flips cards from its deck each turn and announces the End of the Round when it is empty.
The four Spells that target other players are removed.
solo_conquest.game_end:
All cities conquered: finish this turn, then play one last turn, without the Dummy player.
Otherwise, the game ends after the 6th round.
solo_conquest.scoring:
Your Fame, plus the Achievements (no titles in solo play).
+10 per conquered city, +15 if all of them are.
Mission accomplished: +30 per unplayed round, +1 per card in the Dummy player's deck, +5 if the End of the Round was not announced.

crystallize.name: Crystallize
crystallize.basic_text: Pay one mana of a basic color to put a crystal of that color in your Inventory.
crystallize.strong_text: Put a crystal of the basic color of your choice in your Inventory.

mana_draw.name: Mana Draw
mana_draw.basic_text: This turn, you may use one more die from the Source.
mana_draw.strong_text: Take a die from the Source and turn it to the color of your choice, except <gold>gold</gold>. Gain two mana tokens of that color. That die is not rerolled when it goes back to the Source.

concentration.name: Concentration
concentration.strong_text: Play another Action card along with this one: you get its powered effect without paying any mana. If it gives you [[move]]Move, [[influence]]Influence, an [[attack]]Attack or a [[block]]Block, add 2.

improvisation.name: Improvisation
improvisation.basic_text: Discard another card from your hand to get [[move]]Move 3, [[influence]]Influence 3, [[attack]]Attack 3 or [[block]]Block 3.
improvisation.strong_text: Discard another card from your hand to get [[move]]Move 5, [[influence]]Influence 5, [[attack]]Attack 5 or [[block]]Block 5.

mana_pull.name: Mana Pull
mana_pull.basic_text: This turn, you may use one more die from the Source. If it is <black>black</black>, it gives one mana of the color of your choice.
mana_pull.strong_text: Take two dice from the Source and turn each one to the color of your choice, except <gold>gold</gold>. Gain one mana token of each of those colors. Those dice are not rerolled when they go back to the Source.

will_focus.name: Will Focus
will_focus.basic_text: Gain a <blue>blue</blue>, <white>white</white> or <red>red</red> mana token, or put a <green>green</green> crystal in your Inventory.
will_focus.strong_text: Play another Action card along with this one: you get its powered effect without paying any mana. If it gives you [[move]]Move, [[influence]]Influence, an [[attack]]Attack or a [[block]]Block, add 3.

crystal_joy.name: Crystal Joy
crystal_joy.basic_text: Pay one mana of a basic color to put a crystal of that color in your Inventory. At the end of your turn, you may discard another card, but not a Wound, to take this one back into your hand.
crystal_joy.strong_text: Put a crystal of the basic color of your choice in your Inventory. At the end of your turn, you may discard another card, even a Wound, to take this one back into your hand.

noble_manners.name: Noble Manners
noble_manners.basic_text: [[influence]]Influence 2. If you play it during an interaction, you gain 1 [[fame]]Fame right away.
noble_manners.strong_text: [[influence]]Influence 4. If you play it during an interaction, you gain 1 [[fame]]Fame and 1 Reputation right away.

rejuvenate.name: Rejuvenate
rejuvenate.basic_text: Heal 1, draw one card, gain a <green>green</green> mana token, or ready a level I or II unit.
rejuvenate.strong_text: Heal 2, draw two cards, put a <green>green</green> crystal in your Inventory, or ready a level I, II or III unit.

cold_toughness.name: Cold Toughness
cold_toughness.strong_text: [[ice_block]]Ice Block 5, plus 1 for each ability and each attack color shown on the token of the enemy you block (unless it has Arcane Immunity).

fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire_bolt.basic_text: Put a <red>red</red> crystal in your Inventory.

ice_bolt.name: Ice Bolt
ice_bolt.basic_text: Put a <blue>blue</blue> crystal in your Inventory.

swift_bolt.name: Swift Bolt
swift_bolt.basic_text: Put a <white>white</white> crystal in your Inventory.

crushing_bolt.name: Crushing Bolt
crushing_bolt.basic_text: Put a <green>green</green> crystal in your Inventory.

blood_rage.name: Blood Rage
blood_rage.basic_text: [[attack]]Attack 2. You may take a Wound to raise it to [[attack]]Attack 5.
blood_rage.strong_text: [[attack]]Attack 4. You may take a Wound to raise it to [[attack]]Attack 9.

ice_shield.name: Ice Shield
ice_shield.strong_text: [[ice_block]]Ice Block 3. The enemy blocked this way loses 3 [[armor]]Armor, but not below 1.
ice_shield.strong_label: Ice Block 3, the blocked enemy loses 3 Armor

agility.name: Agility

agility.strong_text: [[move]]Move 4. During combat this turn, spend as many Move points as you like: each point gives [[attack]]Attack 1, or each pair of points [[ranged_attack]]Ranged Attack 1.
agility.basic_label: Move 2, each point spent in combat gives Attack 1
agility.strong_label: Move 4, in combat 1 point gives Attack 1 or 2 points Ranged Attack 1

refreshing_walk.name: Refreshing Walk
refreshing_walk.basic_text: [[move]]Move 2 and Heal 1. Played during a combat, it only gives [[move]]Move 2.
refreshing_walk.strong_text: [[move]]Move 4 and Heal 2. Played during a combat, it only gives [[move]]Move 4.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.basic_text: [[influence]]Influence 4 or [[attack]]Attack 3. At the end of your turn, you lose 1 Reputation.
intimidate.strong_text: [[influence]]Influence 8 or [[attack]]Attack 7. At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Reputation.

frost_bridge.name: Frost Bridge
frost_bridge.basic_text: [[move]]Move 2. This turn, entering a swamp costs 1 Move point.
frost_bridge.strong_text: [[move]]Move 4. This turn, you may cross lakes, and entering a lake or a swamp costs 1 Move point.
frost_bridge.strong_label: Move 4, lakes crossable, lakes and swamps cost 1 this turn

song_of_wind.basic_text: [[move]]Move 2. This turn, plains, deserts and wastelands cost 1 Move point less, down to 0.
song_of_wind.strong_text: [[move]]Move 2. This turn, plains, deserts and wastelands cost 2 Move points less, down to 0. You may pay one <blue>blue</blue> mana to cross lakes this turn, for 0 Move points.
song_of_wind.basic_label: Move 2, plains, deserts and wastelands cost 1 less

path_finding.name: Path Finding
path_finding.basic_text: [[move]]Move 2. This turn, every terrain costs 1 Move point less, but not below 2.
path_finding.strong_text: [[move]]Move 4. This turn, every terrain costs 2 Move points.
path_finding.basic_label: Move 2, every terrain costs 1 less, at least 2

blood_ritual.name: Blood Ritual
blood_ritual.basic_text: Take a Wound. Put a <red>red</red> crystal in your Inventory and gain a mana token of the color of your choice, <gold>gold</gold> and <black>black</black> included.
blood_ritual.strong_text: Take a Wound. Gain three mana tokens of the colors of your choice, <gold>gold</gold> and <black>black</black> included. You may pay one mana of a basic color to gain a crystal of that color.

pure_magic.name: Pure Magic
pure_magic.basic_text: Pay one mana as you play this card. <green>Green</green>: [[move]]Move 4. <white>White</white>: [[influence]]Influence 4. <blue>Blue</blue>: [[block]]Block 4. <red>Red</red>: [[attack]]Attack 4.
pure_magic.strong_text: Pay one mana as you play this card. <green>Green</green>: [[move]]Move 7. <white>White</white>: [[influence]]Influence 7. <blue>Blue</blue>: [[block]]Block 7. <red>Red</red>: [[attack]]Attack 7.

heroic_tale.name: Heroic Tale
heroic_tale.basic_text: [[influence]]Influence 3. At the end of your turn, you gain 1 Reputation for each unit recruited this turn.
heroic_tale.strong_text: [[influence]]Influence 6. At the end of your turn, you gain 1 [[fame]]Fame and 1 Reputation for each unit recruited this turn.
heroic_tale.strong_label: Influence 6, Fame +1 and Reputation +1 per unit recruited

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.basic_text: Heal 1. Ready one of your level I or II units.
regeneration.strong_text: Heal 2. Ready one of your level I, II or III units.

into_the_heat.name: Into the Heat
into_the_heat.basic_text: Play it at the start of a combat. During that combat, the [[attack]]Attack and [[block]]Block of all your units go up by 2. This turn, you cannot assign damage to your units.
into_the_heat.strong_text: Play it at the start of a combat. During that combat, the [[attack]]Attack and [[block]]Block of all your units go up by 3. This turn, you cannot assign damage to your units.
into_the_heat.basic_label: Units +2 Attack and Block, no damage to them
into_the_heat.strong_label: Units +3 Attack and Block, no damage to them

steady_tempo.name: Steady Tempo
steady_tempo.basic_text: [[move]]Move 2. At the end of your turn, you may put it at the bottom of your deck instead of discarding it, if the deck is not empty.
steady_tempo.strong_text: [[move]]Move 4. At the end of your turn, you may put it on top of your deck instead of discarding it.
steady_tempo.basic_label: Move 2, may go to the bottom of your deck
steady_tempo.strong_label: Move 4, may go on top of your deck

diplomacy.name: Diplomacy
diplomacy.basic_text: [[influence]]Influence 2. This turn, you may use Influence as [[block]]Block.
diplomacy.strong_text: [[influence]]Influence 4. Choose ice or fire: this turn, you may use Influence as [[block]]Block of that element.
diplomacy.basic_label: Influence 2, Influence counts as Block this turn

in_need.name: In Need
in_need.basic_text: [[influence]]Influence 3, plus 1 for each Wound in your hand or on one of your units.
in_need.strong_text: [[influence]]Influence 5, plus 2 for each Wound in your hand or on one of your units.

decompose.name: Decompose
decompose.basic_text: As you play this card, destroy an Action card from your hand. Gain two crystals of the destroyed card's color.
decompose.strong_text: As you play this card, destroy an Action card from your hand. Gain one crystal of each basic color other than the destroyed card's.

crystal_mastery.name: Crystal Mastery
crystal_mastery.basic_text: Gain a crystal of a color you already have a crystal of.
crystal_mastery.strong_text: The crystals you spend this turn come back to your Inventory at the end of the turn.
crystal_mastery.strong_label: Crystals spent come back at the end of the turn

mana_storm.name: Mana Storm
mana_storm.basic_text: Choose a Source die showing a basic color. Gain a crystal of that color, then reroll that die right away and put it back in the Source.
mana_storm.strong_text: Reroll all the Source dice. This turn, you may use three more dice from the Source, and a <black>black</black> or <gold>gold</gold> die gives one mana of the basic color of your choice, by day or by night.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.basic_text: [[move]]Move 2. This turn, the first [[attack]]Attack card you play gets 1 more, or the first [[block]]Block card gets 2 more, whichever comes first.
ambush.strong_text: [[move]]Move 4. This turn, the first [[attack]]Attack card you play gets 2 more, or the first [[block]]Block card gets 4 more, whichever comes first.
ambush.basic_label: Move 2, first Attack +1 or first Block +2
ambush.strong_label: Move 4, first Attack +2 or first Block +4

maximal_effect.name: Maximal Effect
maximal_effect.basic_text: Play another Action card along with this one: you use its basic effect three times, then you destroy it.
maximal_effect.strong_text: Play another Action card along with this one: you use its powered effect twice, without paying any mana, then you destroy it.

magic_talent.name: Magic Talent
magic_talent.basic_text: Discard a card from your hand. This turn, you may play a Spell of the same color from the Spell offer as if it were in your hand. The Spell stays in the offer.
magic_talent.strong_text: Pay one mana as you play this card. Take a Spell of that color from the offer and put it in your discard pile.
magic_talent.basic_label: A Spell of the same color from the offer, played as if in hand

learning.name: Learning
learning.basic_text: [[influence]]Influence 2. Once this turn, you may pay 6 Influence to take an Advanced Action from the offer and put it in your discard pile.
learning.strong_text: [[influence]]Influence 4. Once this turn, you may pay 9 Influence to take an Advanced Action from the offer and put it in your hand.
learning.basic_label: Influence 2, an Advanced Action from the offer for 6 Influence
learning.strong_label: Influence 4, an Advanced Action from the offer into your hand for 9 Influence

training.name: Training
training.basic_text: Destroy an Action card from your hand, then take an Advanced Action of the same color from the offer and put it in your discard pile.
training.strong_text: Destroy an Action card from your hand, then take an Advanced Action of the same color from the offer and put it in your hand.

expose.name: Expose
expose.basic_text: During this combat, one enemy loses all its [[fortified]]fortifications and all its resistances. [[ranged_attack]]Ranged Attack 2.
expose.strong_text: During this combat, all enemies lose their [[fortified]]fortifications, or all lose their resistances. [[ranged_attack]]Ranged Attack 3.
expose.basic_label: One enemy loses fortifications and resistances, Ranged Attack 2

tremor.name: Tremor
tremor.basic_text: One enemy loses 3 [[armor]]Armor, or all enemies lose 2 [[armor]]Armor. Armor does not go below 1.
tremor.strong_text: One enemy loses 3 [[armor]]Armor (6 if it is [[fortified]]fortified), or all enemies lose 2 [[armor]]Armor (4 for those that are [[fortified]]fortified). Armor does not go below 1.
tremor.strong_label_2: All enemies: Armor −2, −4 for fortified ones (min. 1)

flame_wall.name: Flame Wall
flame_wall.strong_text: [[fire_attack]]Fire Attack 5 or [[fire_block]]Fire Block 7, plus 2 for each enemy you are facing.

mana_bolt.name: Mana Bolt
mana_bolt.basic_text: Pay one mana as you play this card. <blue>Blue</blue>: [[ice_attack]]Ice Attack 8. <red>Red</red>: [[cold_fire_attack]]Cold Fire Attack 7. <white>White</white>: [[ranged_ice_attack]]Ranged Ice Attack 6. <green>Green</green>: [[siege_ice_attack]]Siege Ice Attack 5.
mana_bolt.strong_text: Pay one mana as you play this card. <blue>Blue</blue>: [[ice_attack]]Ice Attack 11. <red>Red</red>: [[cold_fire_attack]]Cold Fire Attack 10. <white>White</white>: [[ranged_ice_attack]]Ranged Ice Attack 9. <green>Green</green>: [[siege_ice_attack]]Siege Ice Attack 8.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.basic_text: One enemy does not attack during this combat.
whirlwind.strong_text: Play it only during the Attack phase of a combat. Destroy one enemy.
whirlwind.strong_label: Destroy an enemy in the Attack phase

underground_travel.name: Underground Travel
underground_travel.basic_text: Move up to 3 revealed spaces, without entering or crossing a swamp or a lake. You must end on a safe space. This move does not provoke rampaging enemies.
underground_travel.strong_text: Move up to 3 revealed spaces, without entering or crossing a swamp or a lake, and end on a [[fortified]]fortified site: your move stops there and it is an assault, in which you ignore the site's fortifications. This move does not provoke rampaging enemies. If you retreat after the combat, go back to the space you started from.
underground_travel.strong_label: Up to 3 spaces, assault a fortified site ignoring its fortifications

burning_shield.name: Burning Shield
burning_shield.basic_text: [[fire_block]]Fire Block 4. If this card is used for a successful block, you may use it in the Attack phase as [[fire_attack]]Fire Attack 4.
burning_shield.strong_text: [[fire_block]]Fire Block 4. If this card is used for a successful block, the blocked enemy is destroyed.
burning_shield.basic_label: Fire Block 4, then Fire Attack 4 if the block succeeds
burning_shield.strong_label: Fire Block 4, the blocked enemy is destroyed if the block succeeds

chill.name: Chill
chill.basic_text: One enemy does not attack during this combat. If it has fire resistance, it loses it until the end of the turn.
chill.strong_text: One enemy does not attack during this combat, and it loses 4 [[armor]]Armor until the end of the turn, but not below 1.
chill.basic_label: One enemy does not attack and loses its fire resistance
chill.strong_label: One enemy does not attack and loses 4 Armor

wings_of_wind.name: Wings of Wind
wings_of_wind.basic_text: As you play this card, spend 1 to 5 Move points and move that many revealed spaces. You must end on a safe space. This move does not provoke rampaging enemies.
wings_of_wind.strong_text: One enemy does not attack during this combat. You may target more enemies by paying Move points: 1 for the second enemy, 2 for the third, 3 for the fourth, and so on.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.basic_text: Heal 3, or Heal 5 if you are in a forest.
restoration.strong_text: Heal 3, or Heal 5 if you are in a forest. Ready units whose levels add up to 3, or to 5 in a forest.
restoration.strong_label: Heal 3, 5 in a forest, and units readied

demolish.name: Demolish
demolish.basic_text: This turn, ignore site fortifications. Enemies lose 1 [[armor]]Armor, but not below 1.
demolish.strong_text: Play it only during the Attack phase of a combat. Destroy one enemy. The others lose 1 [[armor]]Armor, but not below 1.
demolish.strong_label: Destroy an enemy, the others lose 1 Armor

space_bending.name: Space Bending
space_bending.basic_text: This turn, you may move to a space 2 spaces away, or explore a tile at that distance, as if it were adjacent. The space you skip does not count. Your moves this turn do not provoke rampaging enemies.
space_bending.strong_text: At the end of your turn, take back into your hand the other cards played this turn (not the ones discarded or destroyed). Do not draw cards, and take another turn right away.
space_bending.basic_label: Spaces 2 away count as adjacent this turn, without provoking
space_bending.strong_label: Another turn with the cards played

call_to_arms.name: Call to Arms
call_to_arms.basic_text: This turn, you may use one ability of a unit in the offer as if you had recruited it. You cannot assign damage to it.
call_to_arms.strong_text: Recruit a unit from the offer for free. If you already have as many units as command tokens, disband one first.
call_to_arms.basic_label: Ability of a unit in the offer, no damage to it
call_to_arms.strong_label: Recruit a unit from the offer for free

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.basic_text: Pick two cards at random from your discard pile and put them on top of or under your deck. At the end of this turn, draw two cards more than your Hand limit.
meditation.strong_text: Choose two cards from your discard pile and put them on top of or under your deck. At the end of this turn, draw two cards more than your Hand limit.
meditation.basic_label: Two random cards from your discard pile on or under your deck, draw 2 more cards
meditation.strong_label: Two chosen cards from your discard pile on or under your deck, draw 2 more cards

mana_meltdown.name: Mana Meltdown
mana_meltdown.basic_text: Each other player loses a random crystal from their Inventory. You may take one of the crystals lost this way. A player who had no crystal takes a Wound instead.
mana_meltdown.strong_text: Choose a basic color. Each player, you included, takes a Wound for each crystal of that color they have. Gain two crystals of that color.

mana_claim.name: Mana Claim
mana_claim.basic_text: Take a Source die showing a basic color and keep it until the end of the Round. Gain three mana tokens of that color this turn, or one token of that color on each of your following turns until the end of the Round.
mana_claim.strong_text: As Mana Claim. Also, until the end of the Round, another player who uses mana of that color during their turn takes a Wound, only one per turn.

mind_read.name: Mind Read
mind_read.basic_text: Choose a color and gain a crystal of that color. Each other player discards a Spell or an Action card of that color from their hand, or shows their hand to prove they have none.
mind_read.strong_text: As Mind Read. Also, you may steal one of the Action cards (not a Spell) discarded this way and put it in your hand.

energy_flow.name: Energy Flow
energy_flow.basic_text: Ready a unit. If you do, you may spend a unit of level II or lower of each other player.
energy_flow.strong_text: Ready a unit and heal it. If you do, you may spend a unit of level III or lower of each other player.

banner_of_glory.name: Banner of Glory
banner_of_glory.basic_text: Give it to one of your units. That unit gets 1 more [[armor]]Armor and 1 more on each of its attacks and blocks. Each time it attacks or blocks, you gain 1 [[fame]]Fame.

banner_of_glory.strong_label: Units +1 Armor, Attack and Block, Fame +1 per unit that attacks or blocks

banner_of_fear.name: Banner of Fear
banner_of_fear.basic_text: Give it to one of your units. During the Block phase, you may spend that unit to cancel an enemy attack. If you do, you gain 1 [[fame]]Fame.

banner_of_protection.name: Banner of Protection
banner_of_protection.basic_text: Give it to one of your units. That unit gets 1 more [[armor]]Armor, fire resistance and ice resistance.
banner_of_protection.strong_text: At the end of your turn, you may destroy all the Wounds you received this turn.
banner_of_protection.strong_label: Destroy the Wounds received this turn

banner_of_courage.name: Banner of Courage
banner_of_courage.basic_text: Give it to one of your units. Once per Round, outside combat, you may flip the Banner face down to ready that unit. It turns face up again at the start of the next Round.
banner_of_courage.strong_text: Play it at any time outside combat. Ready all your units.

ruby_ring.name: Ruby Ring
ruby_ring.basic_text: Gain a <red>red</red> mana token and a <red>red</red> crystal. You gain 1 [[fame]]Fame.
ruby_ring.strong_text: This turn, you have as much <red>red</red> and <black>black</black> mana as you want. You gain 1 [[fame]]Fame for each <red>red</red> Spell you cast this turn.
ruby_ring.strong_label: Unlimited <red>red</red> and <black>black</black> mana, Fame +1 per <red>red</red> Spell

sapphire_ring.name: Sapphire Ring
sapphire_ring.basic_text: Gain a <blue>blue</blue> mana token and a <blue>blue</blue> crystal. You gain 1 [[fame]]Fame.
sapphire_ring.strong_text: This turn, you have as much <blue>blue</blue> and <black>black</black> mana as you want. You gain 1 [[fame]]Fame for each <blue>blue</blue> Spell you cast this turn.

arythea.name: Arythea
arythea.description: Her cult is whispered to have caused the Breaking. Back from the chaos stronger than ever, she lends her blade to the Council of the Void, as long as blood flows for her god.
arythea.style:
Offensive: fire and siege attacks, ideal to assault fortified sites.
Stronger at night: moves and negotiates better in the dark, makes use of black mana.
Turns pain to her advantage: her Wounds can help instead of clogging her hand.
Less at ease recruiting or healing: for players who like risk.

goldyx.name: Goldyx
goldyx.description: Out of the Surge stronger than any of his kind, he trusts no one. The Council of the Void sent him on a mission, but only treasures and worthy foes interest him.
goldyx.style:
Master of mana: gains crystals and tokens at will, and powers almost all his cards.
Excellent with Spells, which he fuels with ease.
Can fly over the terrain and block the Source for others.
Often considered the strongest, but his mana needs careful planning.

norowas.name: Norowas
norowas.description: Once the leader of the elven armies, he joined the Council of the Void to impose his order on the kingdoms born of the Breaking, without mercy or hesitation.
norowas.style:
Warlord: his Units attack and block harder, and help him move faster.
Diplomat: high Influence by day, extra Fame and Reputation when he recruits.
Keeps his troops fit: heals or readies a Unit, recruits for less.
Weaker alone in combat early on: he must surround himself quickly.

tovak.name: Tovak
tovak.description: The Ninth Circle sold its swords to the highest bidder; under his grip, it became a power. He embraces the Council of the Void's conquests as long as they strike the factions that scorn his people.
tovak.style:
Solid warrior: attacks, blocks and shoots without relying on mana.
Breaks enemy resistances and takes Wounds without weakening.
Gets the most out of cards played sideways: little mana, lots of effect.
The easiest to learn: recommended for a first game.

rule.fortified: During ranged attacks, only siege attacks can reach it; none at all if it also defends a fortified site.
rule.swift: Blocking it takes Block equal to twice its attack.
rule.brutal: If not blocked, it deals twice its attack in damage.
rule.poison: A unit it wounds receives two Wounds. For each Wound it puts into the hero's hand, another one goes to the discard pile.
rule.paralyze: A unit it wounds is destroyed. If the hero takes a Wound into their hand, they discard every card in hand that is not a Wound.
rule.summon: At the start of the block phase, a creature drawn from the dungeon pile takes its place for blocking and damage, then is discarded.
rule.resistance_physical: Physical attacks, sideways cards included, only count half against it.
rule.resistance_fire: Fire attacks only count half against it, and cold fire too if it also resists ice. It ignores other effects of red cards and of unit abilities paid with red mana.
rule.resistance_ice: Ice attacks only count half against it, and cold fire too if it also resists fire. It ignores other effects of blue cards and of unit abilities paid with blue mana.
rule.attack_fire: Only ice and cold fire blocks count in full; others count half.
rule.attack_ice: Only fire and cold fire blocks count in full; others count half.
rule.attack_cold_fire: Only cold fire blocks count in full; others count half.

right_moment.text: Once this Day, during your turn: announce that you will take another turn right after this one. The Tactic flips over.

long_night.name: Long Night
long_night.text: Once this Night, if your deck is empty: shuffle your discard pile and put 3 random cards from it back into your deck. The Tactic flips over.

mana_search.name: Mana Search
mana_search.text: Once per turn, before using mana from the Source: you may reroll up to two Source dice. If there are <gold>gold</gold> dice, reroll them first.

midnight_meditation.name: Midnight Meditation
midnight_meditation.text: Once this Night, before one of your turns: shuffle up to 5 cards from your hand into your deck, Wounds included, then draw as many. The Tactic flips over.

preparation.name: Preparation
preparation.text: When you take it: search your deck for the card of your choice and put it in your hand, then shuffle the deck.

sparing_power.name: Sparing Power
sparing_power.text: Before each of your turns, choose one: put the top card of your deck face down under this card, or flip the Tactic and take all the cards under it into your hand.
